leads.title: Sevcik v. Sandoval - Ninth Circuit Court of Appeals
leads.documents: Federal ruling that struck down Nevada Question 2 same-sex marriage ban, reversing District Judge Robert Jones Nov 29 ruling, making same-sex marriage legal Oct 7-8, 2014
leads.detail: Cited in text as Lambda Legal lawsuit filed April 10, 2012 in U.S. District Court for District of Nevada on behalf of eight couples; Ninth Circuit decision Oct 7, 2014

leads.title: Nevada Constitution - Question 2 (2020) and Question 1 / SJR8A (2022)
leads.documents: Voter-approved constitutional enshrinement of same-sex marriage rights (62% in 2020) and addition of 'sexual orientation and gender identity or expression' to equal protection clause (58% in 2022)
leads.detail: Cited as Question 2 Nov 3, 2020 removing 2002 ban language; SJR8A passed 2019 and March 2021 sessions, on ballot Nov 2022 as Question 1

leads.title: Nevada Legislature A.B. 211, S.B. 331, S.B. 368
leads.documents: 2011 laws prohibiting discrimination in employment, housing and public accommodation on basis of 'gender identity or expression' plus sexual orientation protections from 1999
leads.detail: Cited as signed by Gov. Brian Sandoval, took effect Oct 1, 2011; builds on 1999 sexual orientation employment/public accommodations law

leads.title: Nevada Hate Crime Law - S.B. 139 (2013)
leads.documents: Addition of 'gender identity or expression' to hate crime penalty enhancement law; prior 2001 amendment covered sexual orientation only
leads.detail: Cited as passed Senate 20-1, Assembly 30-11 May 14, signed by Gov. Sandoval May 21, 2013, effective Oct 1, 2013; prior S.B.180 2011 failed

leads.title: Nevada Conversion Therapy Ban (2017)
leads.documents: State ban on conversion therapy on minors
leads.detail: Cited as passed Senate 15-5 April 2017, Assembly 31-8 May 9, signed by Gov. Brian Sandoval May 17, effective Jan 1, 2018

leads.title: Nevada Vital Records and Department of Motor Vehicles - Gender Marker Policy
leads.documents: Issuance of corrected birth certificate on two affidavits without surgery requirement; X third-gender designation on licenses, IDs, birth certificates; 2017 repeal of 1988 newspaper name-publication requirement
leads.detail: Cited as policy since 2016 for Vital Records; May 2017 unanimous legislature bill abolishing publication requirement; no medical documentation required for X

leads.title: Nevada Gender-Affirming Healthcare Coverage Laws - SB302 veto and June 2023 mandate
leads.documents: Vetoed 2023 omnibus SB302 to protect gender-affirming care/abortion and mandate Medicaid surgery coverage vs. passed June 2023 law requiring health insurers including Medicaid to cover medically necessary gender-affirming treatments and banning transgender discrimination
leads.detail: Cited as SB302 vetoed by Gov. Joe Lombardo; separate bill passed June 2023 signed into law effective Jan 1, 2024; March 2018 Medicaid agency announcement and June 22, 2017 veto context

leads.title: Nevada 2023 Correctional Facilities Protection Law
leads.documents: Explicit legal protections/shields for transgender and/or intersex inmates within state-based correctional facilities
leads.detail: Cited as bill passed Nevada Legislature May 2023, approved by Gov. Lombardo; noted similar to California, Connecticut, Massachusetts

leads.title: Nevada Interscholastic Activities Association (NIAA) Transgender Athlete Policy
leads.documents: April 2025 reversal of 2016 inclusive policy to require high-school athletes compete per sex at birth; related Gov. Lombardo collegiate restriction push and failed 2026 ballot initiative
leads.detail: Cited as NIAA vote April 2025; initiative would have classified school sports male/female/coeducational based on sex assigned at birth, failed to reach Nov 2026 ballot

leads.title: Movement Advancement Project - Nevada's Equality Profile
leads.documents: Institutional LGBT rights legislation ranking cited for Nevada as first in Mountain West region for LGBT rights legislation
leads.detail: Listed in External links as 'Nevada's Equality Profile – via the Movement Advancement Project'
